policies.text: A utility system supported by clean energy funding gains state procurement registry entry.
Clean energy funding is granted to any power system demonstrating generation efficiency of at least 40 percent, or possessing warranty coverage of 15 years or more.
A biomass heating system achieves municipal smoke compliance when its particulate output remains below 15 milligrams per cubic meter.
An energy storage product secures residential grid connection rights when holding valid UL 1973 safety credentials.
Industrial solar inverter models are designated as premium hardware if their peak conversion ratio exceeds 98 percent.
